name: query-design
context_rationale: The skill is an interactive, back-and-forth Q&A conversation that follows up on user questions, drills down iteratively, and optionally offers a handoff to /slice based on what emerged in the session — it fundamentally depends on the accumulated conversation context.
summary: Holds a read-only, grounded Q&A conversation about an existing codebase, answering questions by reading actual code via Grep, Read, and code-review-graph queries rather than recall. Every answer cites specific file/line/symbol evidence. It changes nothing — no writes, no file creation, no vault mutations. If the conversation surfaces a concrete actionable finding, it offers (but never forces) a single delegated handoff to /slice.

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Grep
harness_tools.purpose: Locate symbols and patterns in the codebase to ground answers in evidence

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Inspect actual file contents and definitions to answer questions accurately

harness_tools.name: Skill
harness_tools.purpose: Invoke /slice once via the Skill tool when the user accepts the offered handoff

missing_references.reason: External pip package, intentionally not bundled in the plugin.
